candidate.strategy_flag: CaptureCompletionStrategy (fixed | adaptive) in new StrokeCompletionMonitor.swift; process-wide CaptureCompletionStrategyStore, ALWAYS 'fixed' at launch, never persisted; settable only via new RN bridge method PickleVideoCapture.setCompletionStrategy (TS wrapper setCaptureCompletionStrategy resolves with the strategy native actually applied and throws when unavailable — no silent flips). No existing feature-flag mechanism reaches Swift (runtimeConfig.ts is build-time TS only), so this is the documented compile-safe default-off runtime switch the task authorized
candidate.adaptive_semantics: StrokeCompletionMonitor mirrors the D-029 bench (eventCompletionBench.ts) verbatim, anchored at the live trigger's peakMotionMs: settle = speed < max(0.15, 0.25×peak) sustained 400ms; next-stroke valley = dip <0.6×peak then rise ≥ max(2×settleThreshold, 1.5×valley) at >80ms after the valley → end at valley; hard safety max anchor+2500ms by CAMERA clock (lost pose stream cannot stall finalize); min follow-through anchor+300ms. Motion series mirrors TemporalStrokeDetector (what peakMotionMs is computed from): per-wrist prior, visibility ≥0.35, gap ≤250ms, fastest wrist, pose confidence ≥0.5. Adaptive clip end is clamped to ≥ detector endMs so the detected motion window (contact) can never be trimmed
candidate.instrumentation_always_on: Both strategies arm the monitor at stroke-event fire and keep a reduced pose-extraction path alive during the post-completion window (extractPose → monitor.ingest only; readiness UI, evidence accumulator, pose sidecar, trigger all untouched). Exported clips gain an additive `completion` block (schemaVersion 1, clip-relative like the trigger block): completionStrategy, algorithmVersion 'completion-monitor-1', movementCompleteMs (=trigger.endMs), anchorMs (=trigger.peakMotionMs), finalizeMs, settleDetectedMs?, valleyDetectedMs?, safetyMaxHit, peakMotionValue, observedUntilMs, observedSampleCount, frozen D-029 params, postCompletionMotion ≤50 downsampled samples (D-023 bounded-evidence pattern). Under 'fixed' the adaptive decision is recorded as a pure shadow — FIXED vs ADAPTIVE becomes comparable on every real capture
candidate.ts_contract: CapturedClip gains optional `completion?: CaptureCompletionTelemetryV1` (imported clips: never). assertCapturedClip validates it when present: cross-checks movementCompleteMs===trigger.endMs and anchorMs===(trigger.peakMotionMs ?? trigger.endMs), single-decision exclusivity (settle XOR valley XOR safety), bounded strictly-increasing post-anchor series, and exact equality with the frozen CAPTURE_COMPLETION_PARAMS_V1 constants — a drifted native retune cannot masquerade as schema v1. Persistence is payload-verbatim (local_capture.payload JSON → re-validated on read), so the telemetry survives storage with zero repository changes

recommendation: Ship the instrument; do NOT flip the default. Promotion checklist (D-027-style, per D-029): (1) collect real guided captures with the instrument live — every clip now carries clip-relative movementCompleteMs/anchorMs/finalizeMs, the shadow adaptive decision, and the ≤50-sample post-anchor wrist-motion series under clip.completion (read path: local_capture.payload → assertCapturedClip → clip.completion; pose sidecar + clip video allow full re-extraction); (2) grow gold events to ≥20 in the parallel labeling workstream and extend eventCompletionBench.ts with a live-replay mode that reads clip.completion instead of idealizing the trigger from label windows — the recorded series replays BOTH policies against gold eventEnd/followThroughEnd/recoveryEnd exactly as the bench does today; (3) promotion requires, on ≥20 gold events with REAL live-trigger anchors: adaptive median |end error| and recovery excess beat fixed, zero contact/follow-through losses, and the two never-settle rally cases stay loss-free under the safety max; (4) sanity-check live-vs-shadow agreement (settle/valley/safety rates, finalize deltas) across strategies on uncontrolled captures before flipping the default, then gate through lab:cascade per D-029's product-level requirement; (5) on promotion, flip only CaptureCompletionStrategyStore's initial value — the fixed path stays replayable behind the same switch, and telemetry keeps recording both sides
risks: Default-mode cost: pose extraction now continues during the 1.5s post-roll (previously idle) on the vision queue. Bounded (~45-90 extra ApplePoseProvider calls per capture, ≤50 samples retained), UI/timing paths untouched — but on-device thermal/latency was NOT measured here (no device in this environment); worth a glance in the next on-device session.

Monitor series is a mirror of TemporalStrokeDetector, not a shared implementation (detector lives in native/vision-core, not owned by this workstream). Two disclosed bounded divergences: no detector-reset mirroring (pre-trigger, gap-gated) and camera-clock safety vs the bench's one-sample overshoot at the 2500ms edge. The recorded series lets replay quantify both per capture; consider extracting a shared series helper into vision-core when that package is in scope.

TS validator freezes params to the D-029 constants: any native retune MUST bump completion schemaVersion or clips will be rejected at the RN boundary (intentional drift-guard; failure mode is loud, not silent).

Adaptive mode (flag on) can legitimately produce clips with postRollMs as low as 0 (valley at/before detector endMs): the detected motion window is always preserved, but downstream consumers assuming ~1.5s of trailing context should be re-checked before promotion — this is exactly what the ≥20-event replay will measure.
